详情仍保留播放控件与失败后打开视频的入口；变化需交互体验。: Retain playback controls and a fallback link in details; experience the change through interaction.
详情重组为图文布局，加入共用详情渲染和语言模块。: Reorganize details into image/text layouts and add shared detail rendering and language modules.
调整 Project app、样式和 reading-nav 模块。: Adjust the Project app, styles and reading-nav module.
调整介绍区到事实栏之间的留白，空间足够时让事实栏底边对齐图片。: Adjust spacing between the introduction and facts section, aligning its bottom with the image when space permits.
调整加载、渲染与发布流程；这次大改发生在此提交，后面的发布说明提交沿用它。: Adjust loading, rendering and publishing. The major redesign occurs in this commit; later publishing-note commits retain it.
调整报告查看器，并加入线上预览会话校验。: Adjust the report viewer and add online preview session checks.
调整查看器样式与预览资源。远程签名和 R2 服务仍须另外准备。: Adjust viewer styles and preview assets; remote signatures and R2 services still require separate setup.
返回作品入口使用共享离场动画，各模块同步更新内容。: Use a shared exit animation when returning to work entries and synchronize content across modules.
返回时保留过渡状态，重新进入页面后解除，减少旧画面闪烁。: Keep transition state on return and clear it after re-entering to reduce flashes of old content.
返回时避免旧画面闪现，发布时减少新页面读到旧脚本。: Avoid flashes of old content on return and reduce new pages loading old scripts after publishing.
这两个模块增加 pathname 检查，/about 路径优先使用 About: Add pathname checks in both modules, prioritizing About mode for /about routes.
这是一次包含多个模块的发布包；具体内容以对应页面截图为准。: This release package contains several updated modules; refer to the corresponding screenshots for their actual content.
这是作品集的展示项替换，不是在历史副本里运行整个新闻网站后台。: This replaces a portfolio showcase item; it does not run the entire news website backend in the historical copy.
这是发布产物的较大调整；文件数增加也包括带版本号的素材，不能等同于新增同样多的功: This is a substantial release asset update. File counts include versioned assets and do not indicate equally many new features.
这是发布包这条历史的起点，没有上一份发布包。: The starting point of the release package history; no earlier release package is available.
这是起点，没有上一版。首页展示代码与 AI 项目，点击项目可打开详情。: This is the starting point, with no previous version. The home page shows code and AI projects; click a project to open its details.
这是阅读预览与媒体配置调整，作品索引的静态外观基本不变。: This changes reading previews and media settings; the work index's static appearance remains largely unchanged.
这次包新增带独立版本号的脚本和样式文件，同时更新页面引用。: Add scripts and styles with separate version identifiers and update the page references accordingly.
进入 Project 的第一次加载重新显示计数和环形展开。: Show counting and circular expansion again on the first entry to Project.
重新组织详情图文布局，拆出共用详情渲染和语言模块。: Reorganize detail image/text layouts and extract shared detail rendering and language modules.
需要在手机尺寸下滚动体验，单张桌面截图无法体现展开速度。: Scroll at phone dimensions to experience this change; a single desktop screenshot cannot show the reveal speed.
静态桌面截图几乎相同，手机滚动时才能体验到区别。: Static desktop screenshots are almost identical; the difference is visible while scrolling on mobile.
页面、图片和交互代码与上一版一致，可共用已核对的截图。: Pages, images and interaction code match the previous version; verified screenshots can be shared.
页面与录屏来自本地 Git 存档；远程服务、线上会话权限和发布行为以文件依据为准: Pages and recordings come from local Git archives; refer to file evidence for remote services, online session permissions and publishing behavior.
页面代码与 23:47 的上一版一致；不能把这个提交再算一次界面大改。: Page code matches the previous version at 23:47; this commit is not another major interface redesign.
页面排版与项目素材不变；点击网址时才体现此区别。: Page layout and project assets are unchanged; the difference appears when following the URL.
页面文件与上一份发布包一致，只更新发布资料。: Page files match the previous release package; only publishing information changes.
页面文件与上一份源码快照一致。: Page files match the previous source snapshot.
项目介绍改为 GrokBot 云端运营目标，并补充中文字库。: Describe the GrokBot cloud operating goal and add Chinese font subsets.
项目图片和主要布局沿用上一份发布包。: Project images and the main layout retain the previous release package.
项目图片说明同步更新；其他作品和整体布局沿用上一版。: Update image captions while retaining the other works and overall layout from the previous version.
项目封面、介绍与架构说明更新；加入真实新闻页面截图。: Update the project cover, introduction and architecture description and add real news page screenshots.
项目详情、导航、资源、404 与 VI 的语言渲染同步调整。: Synchronize language rendering in project details, navigation, resources, 404 and VI.
首次存档：6 个项目、Work / About 切换和项目详情弹窗。: First archive: six projects, Work / About switching and project detail dialogs.
首页 EN / 中 统一使用全站语言偏好，不再让详情保留另一种语言。: Use the same site-wide language preference for the home page EN / Chinese switch so details do not retain another language.
首页个人 GitHub 入口，以及 Ariadne、Spark、MacSetup: Change the personal GitHub link and source links for Ariadne, Spark and MacSetup to orocoa.
首页作品入口按滚动逐项展开，减少一次额外的停顿。: Reveal home page work entries one by one while scrolling, removing an extra pause.
首页语言选择同步到全站，17 项详情补齐中英内容。: Synchronize the home page language choice across the site and complete bilingual content for 17 project details.
高度不足时继续以正常文档流展示两栏；只有列宽不足才堆叠为单栏。: Keep two columns in normal document flow when height is limited; stack them only when column width is insufficient.
